U03.functional: PASSED in browser against mocked responses only (CHK-U03-BROWSER). Live routes NOT RUN: no Gemini, BigQuery or Firestore here, and the lot guard is off on the live revision (DR-008).
U03.backend: Called through web/src/lib/session.ts send() and api.ts getJson(): POST /orders/extract, GET /conditions/current, POST /jobs (Idempotency-Key, optional lotId), PUT /lots/:lotId/conditions, GET /lots/:lotId, POST /jobs/:id/approve with { reviewConfirmed: true, revisionFingerprint }, GET /jobs/:id/card.pdf (link). GET /conditions/weather is not called by the client: the server falls back to it when humidity is missing. Not connected by design: constraints, model pass levels, board and box size from the catalog, retrying the explanation alone, approving the entered plan.
U03.notes: Differences from the design: (1) Every figure comes from the server response, so the design's October figures appear only in test fixtures (PD-12, PD-22). (2) Source card is built from the fields read (line, item code, quantity), not the original page; no description column; the design's grey placeholder lines 2 and 3 are not drawn; footer reads 'Built from the fields read, not the original page.' (3) 'Board' and 'Box style and size' read Not recorded with a Missing chip, and the catalog check 'Board and size come from the catalog' became 'Board and size are not connected yet' (PD-20). (4) Added 'Paper' row when paper type and supplier are unknown (PD-20). (5) Approve checkbox added (PD-20). (6) Constraints and trust cards, Keep entered plan and Retry explanation show not-connected states; the trade-off card lists the server's per-defect rates (PD-21). (7) The design's 'Route on the card' strip and 'Risk evidence' row are not drawn: no source in the job response. (8) Toast text is built from real state ('3 changes recommended', not '3 changes from 8,640 combinations'); at most two toasts, non-error ones clear after 8 s and on each step change; the bell count in the top bar belongs to the shell. (9) Conditions prefill from GET /conditions/current with the note 'There is no plant sensor feed...'; fields count as done when valid, as in the design. Sublabels use 'Reference record, ...' wording instead of the design's example 'Confirmed by the operator'. (10) 'Card checked' reads Not recorded: nothing reports it. (11) Under 1300px the id strip tightens; under 1100px columns stack (no design). (12) Stepper now draws a check for finished steps, as the design does (shared component and foundation.css changed). Edits that supersede a revision go through PUT /lots/:lotId/conditions before POST /jobs; staleness is read from GET /lots/:lotId on entering Review and on window focus, and depends on the lot store flag (DR-008). Data class reads 'Synthetic demonstration' for approved samples and 'Uploaded order' otherwise.

'Do the three changes' uses the lot's change count; '8,640 tries' shows only when a count is supplied, otherwise '3 changes max'. The design's top bar shows 'Prototype data, not live', a bell badge and 'Prep Flow' breadcrumb; the shared shell does not, and the preview route shows 'Home' in the breadcrumb. The bell badge is not built. Toast reuses the New Lot toast measurements in prep-flow.css rather than a shared component. The 1128 px drawing scales to 80% at narrow widths and scrolls below that, scrolled to the current step; the hero row wraps at 1280 and 1024.
